title: Facing a ban, Manhattan's horse carriage drivers fear for their future | AP News

Facing a ban, Manhattan's horse carriage drivers fear for their future | AP News

# Central Park’s horse-drawn carriage drivers fear for their future as New York City passes a ban

The horse-drawn carriages that have cruised through Central Park for more than 150 years are set to be banished soon from New York City, ending an iconic tradition beloved by tourists but long opposed by animal welfare activists. (AP video by Joseph B. Frederick)

Supporters have welcomed the ban on horse-drawn carriage rides after the New York City Council passed a bill on Thursday that would prohibit the rides by June
